title: Scheduled Contact-Lens Fitting Fee on a Vision Plans Exam Visit
content:
**Fee schedule entry — contact-lens fitting with a routine eye exam (Vision Plans)**

The scheduled fee of an exam visit's contact-lens fitting follows the visit's lines:

- **120.00** when the routine exam comes with a specialty contact-lens fitting line;
- **70.00** when it comes with a standard contact-lens fitting line;
- **no fitting fee (0.00)** when the visit is a routine exam without a fitting line.

| Lines on the claim | Scheduled fitting fee |
|---|---|
| Routine eye exam and a specialty contact-lens fitting | 120.00 |
| Routine eye exam and a standard contact-lens fitting | 70.00 |
| Routine eye exam only | 0.00 |

The kind of fitting is read from the fitting line itself, as specialty or standard.

*Hypothetical comparison.* A specialty fitting billed at 141.30 alongside a routine exam meets a scheduled fee of 120.00, while a standard fitting billed at the same 141.30 meets a scheduled fee of 70.00.
